temp_trend.label: Warming
temp_trend.description: How fast the yearly mean air temperature changed over 1991-2025 in this cell. Mean temperature is (daily Tmax + Tmin) / 2, an approximation of the true daily mean. Historical statistic of reanalysis data (MERRA-2 via NASA POWER), not a forecast.
temp_trend.source: NASA POWER daily, community AG, 1991-2025 (MERRA-2 reanalysis); ETo = FAO-56 Penman-Monteith (core/eto.py)

heavy_share.label: Rain in heavy-rain days
heavy_share.description: Share of the yearly rain that fell on heavy-rain days. A heavy-rain day is defined relative to the cell itself: a wet day (at least 1 mm) with more rain than this cell's own 95th percentile of wet-day rain over 1991-2025. This is our own definition, not a standard. Historical statistic of reanalysis data (MERRA-2 via NASA POWER), not a forecast.
heavy_share.source: NASA POWER daily, community AG, 1991-2025 (MERRA-2 reanalysis); ETo = FAO-56 Penman-Monteith (core/eto.py)

water_balance.label: Growing-season water balance
water_balance.description: Rain minus reference evapotranspiration (ETo, the water a well-watered grass surface would use) from April to September. Negative means the atmosphere asks for more water than rain supplies. The Apr-Sep season is our choice; it is not crop-specific. Historical statistic of reanalysis data (MERRA-2 via NASA POWER), not a forecast.
water_balance.source: NASA POWER daily, community AG, 1991-2025 (MERRA-2 reanalysis); ETo = FAO-56 Penman-Monteith (core/eto.py)

heavy_days.label: Heavy-rain days
heavy_days.description: Days per year with rain above this cell's own 95th percentile of wet-day rain (wet day = at least 1 mm). Our own definition. Historical statistic of reanalysis data (MERRA-2 via NASA POWER), not a forecast.
heavy_days.source: NASA POWER daily, community AG, 1991-2025 (MERRA-2 reanalysis); ETo = FAO-56 Penman-Monteith (core/eto.py)

frost_last.label: Last spring frost
frost_last.description: Typical date of the last spring frost (50 % date, 1991-2025). Method follows the usual NOAA frost-date approach: for each year, the date of the LAST spring frost with daily minimum air temperature at or below the chosen threshold (searched 1 Jan-31 Jul); then the 10 %, 50 % and 90 % dates across years. Thresholds are NOAA conventions: 0 °C (32 °F, light freeze), -2.2 °C (28 °F, hard freeze), -4.4 °C (24 °F, severe freeze). Only years with a missing day in the search window are skipped, never filled. A year with no frost at or below the threshold in the window still counts as an observation (its last frost is before 1 Jan, or its first frost after 31 Dec); if a percentile falls on such a year, no date is given (no frost by then / frost-free through December). Reanalysis 1991-2025 stands in for station records, and a 50 km MERRA-2 cell is smoother than a weather station, so real local frosts are more frequent and happen later in spring / earlier in autumn than shown here. Reading the dates: the 90 % date = by this date, 9 in 10 years have seen their last spring frost (conservative planting date); the 10 % date = only 1 in 10 years has had its last frost by then. The same percentile convention is used for first autumn frost. Historical statistic of reanalysis data (MERRA-2 via NASA POWER), not a forecast.
frost_last.source: NASA POWER daily, community AG, 1991-2025 (MERRA-2 reanalysis); ETo = FAO-56 Penman-Monteith (core/eto.py)

Method follows the usual NOAA frost-date approach: for each year, the date of the last spring / first autumn frost with daily minimum air temperature at or below the chosen threshold (searched 1 Jan-31 Jul and 1 Aug-31 Dec); then the 10 %, 50 % and 90 % dates across years. Thresholds are NOAA conventions: 0 °C (32 °F, light freeze), -2.2 °C (28 °F, hard freeze), -4.4 °C (24 °F, severe freeze). Only years with a missing day in the search window are skipped, never filled. Historical statistic of reanalysis data (MERRA-2 via NASA POWER), not a forecast.
frost_season.source: NASA POWER daily, community AG, 1991-2025 (MERRA-2 reanalysis); ETo = FAO-56 Penman-Monteith (core/eto.py)
